title: CPS PIL GenreInterpretation 1.0 (DRAFT, non-normative)
description: Design draft mirroring the existing perceptual_interpretation_report.schema.json $defs/genre shape, which section 3.3 of docs/song_program_pil_genre_interpretation_draft.md proposes to reuse unchanged. This file is NOT a contract schema. The score formulas behind the four Q0.10000 values are open decision G3; this draft fixes only the row shape and the ordering rule (sort by -typicality_q, then genre ordinal).
